import { Component, AfterViewInit } from '@angular/core'; import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router'; import { initFakeSubmit } from '../../shared/auth-common'; declare const document: any; @Component({ selector: 'app-forgot-password', standalone: true, imports: [RouterLink], templateUrl: './forgot-password.component.html', styleUrl: './forgot-password.component.css' }) export class ForgotPasswordComponent implements AfterViewInit { ngAfterViewInit(): void { const form = document.getElementById('forgot-form'); const success = document.getElementById('forgot-success'); initFakeSubmit('forgot-form', 'forgot-submit', () => { form.style.display = 'none'; success.style.display = 'flex'; }); } }
